ev.q: This report describes an investigation of S. sonnei cases that occurred among MSM in San Francisco during May--December 2000.
Shigella sonnei Outbreak Among Men Who Have Sex with Men

This report describes an investigation of S. sonnei cases

106 were selected randomly for telephone interview
denominator data obtained from the annual San Francisco HIV/AIDS epidemiology report
San Francisco, California, 2000--2001
